body:
Adds engine-owned execution of a configured worker selected by an accepted endpoint proposal. `task-worker-execute` binds the exact task, selection receipt and configuration, rechecks authority, reserves the existing task budget and shared endpoint capacity, and retains the draft and actual usage in the task-attempt ledger. Readback and replay do not redispatch. A draft is not an accepted project edit, task success, model qualification or training consent.

Current candidate: `604c196df473105b041998e1266bb5727f846a04`, reconciled with development main `1fd7f163de3448c694e09c916b328540303eab1c`. Twenty conflicts were resolved from source contracts and regenerated projections. Main's ignored request extensions remain non-authoritative; they do not admit LFG observations. All 92 main-only staged objects were preserved exactly. OpenAPI has 79 operations and digest `4186a8f279fd213b592d54d5061717a8f27ce0a85aeba145aeda5ef24c025f2e`.

The owning outcome is OBJ-06 / G-01b/G-02a and POAM-009. Scope is the canonical worker contract, engine attempt/completion authority, transport/client binding, generated SDK surfaces, installed controller driver and linked evidence. No alternate scheduler or project-effect authority is introduced. The source mapping and before/after oracles are retained in the [worker admission journal](https://github.com/rrflow/rrflow-development/blob/codex/task-worker-model/docs/evidence/change-journals/gate-g/task-worker-model-admission.md) and [current reconciliation record](https://github.com/rrflow/rrflow-development/blob/codex/task-worker-model/docs/evidence/change-journals/gate-g/task-worker-main-reconciliation-20261106.md).

Local validation on the reconciled tree:
- Contract/client suites: 205 passed; focused worker tests: nine passed.
- Full engine library: 352 passed, four ignored native fixtures; evaluation: 57 passed.
- TypeScript generation/lint/typecheck and seven tests; Python SDK eight passed, two installed tests skipped; Go SDK tests passed.
- Generated-surface parity, synthetic storage projection refresh, formatting, documentation, navigation and execution inventory passed. No native receipt was rewritten. The journal records one interrupted redundant compiler invocation separately from passed tests.

The PR remains draft until exact-revision installed worker readback is refreshed and required candidate/merge CI passes. Historical real-provider and controlled-provider receipts prove only their named source/binary combinations. The production consumer still missing is the public UI prompt flight: `PromptFlightProvider` supports only `Observe`, and a prepared flight calls no provider. Continue the same `installed_controller_proof.py --worker` journey into a correctly bound prompt/task/context/attempt consumer after this dependency lands. Ordinary-edit successor plans, verified project effects, triggered assessment cycles and reviewed learning remain open.

Research decision: no upstream adaptation or new external research was needed for the merge. Existing bounded attempt/configuration/input identities remain the debug boundary; serial Rust compilation avoids the prior memory failure. Stop on changed candidate ownership, unexplained semantic/authority drift, uncertain external effects or unavailable required provider evidence. Do not fabricate outcomes, reassign old evidence to new source, or weaken CI to land.
title: Execute selected worker models through engine-owned task attempts
